title: データサイエンス入門
subtitle: Introduction to Data Science
courseType: Design Project ProgramDesign Project CoursesDesign Project
educationalGoal: Learn the basics of data handling. In this course, you will learn the basic operations of the spreadsheet software Excel, which is an introductory tool for handling data. Then, using Excel, you will learn data handling skills such as aggregation and analysis of experimental data and questionnaire data. In addition, we will visualize actual datasets from the real world using Excel, and thereby gain an understanding of the meaning of the data and acquire the ability to aggregate and analyze the data.
advice:
In this course, you will learn the following basic knowledge as an introduction to data science.

1. Basic operations of Excel: Learn the basic operations of the spreadsheet software Excel, which is an introductory tool for handling data.
2. Aggregation/analysis of experimental data: Use Excel to aggregate/analyze experimental data.
3. Questionnaire data aggregation/analysis: Use Excel to aggregate/analyze questionnaire data.
4. Aggregation/analysis of open data: Use Excel to aggregate/analyze open data.

Each class session includes a quiz using video materials and the e-syllabus. Students who complete the quiz (scoring full marks) by the day before the class session are exempt from attending the in-person session for that particular session only.
There are seven class sessions. Missing three or more sessions will result in failure (due to poor attendance).
Pass/fail is determined by the final report. Only students who have passed all quizzes from the 1st to 7th class session will be permitted to begin the final report.
books: Introduction to ICT/Introduction to Data Science 2026(Kanazawa Institute of Technology)
requiredKnowledge:
No prior knowledge or skills are assumed.
You will use your own laptop computer to do the exercises.
Be sure to bring your laptop computer, power adapter, and network cable (LAN cable) to each class.

activityGoals.body: To be able to perform basic operations in the spreadsheet software Excel.
To be able to use Excel to aggregate and analyze experimental data.
To be able to use Excel to aggregate and analyze questionnaire data.
To be able to use Excel to aggregate and analyze open data.
